## Observation

State whether this concerns current repository documentation, the historical prototype, or a future requirement.

## Evidence

Link the document, version, source, or screenshot. Remove credentials and unrelated personal information.

## Expected behavior and impact

Reference the requirement or decision if known.

## Suggested next investigation

Mark hypotheses as hypotheses. Do not claim an implementation defect has been fixed without evidence.
